messages:
maria.gonzalez: Quick update — pleased to announce Claire Wu is joining Redwood Inference as Head of Cost Optimization, starting Mon 4/8. Claire will report to Priya (Runtime Head) and own cross-product cost strategy, batching/quantization programs, and the Optimize roadmap. :tada:
claire.wu: super excited to be here! looking forward to diving into the current cost playbooks and meeting folks. open to 1:1s next week — calendar invite incoming. :wave:
aj: amazing news — welcome Claire! will you be owning the dedicated pricing models or is that staying with finance?
samir.rao: congrats Claire!! quick Q: will the team structure change immediately or is this a gradual transition?
maria.gonzalez: @aj — Claire will partner closely with Finance on pricing, but strategic levers (batching, quant profiles, model routing) move under Claire for product/ops execution. @samir.rao — gradual; Claire will run a 60-day discovery, then propose org changes if needed.
claire.wu: plan is: weeks 1–4 listen + metrics baseline; weeks 5–8 propose low-risk experiments (batch params, cache tiering); then 30/60/90 rollout. I want to avoid big disruption — focus on measurable wins first.
lucy-k: welcome! any immediate asks for the infra/capacity teams we should prep for?
claire.wu: lucy — yes, access to recent job-level token telemetry, batching histograms, and current quantization experiments. i'll share a short data access checklist by EOD.
ben-t: :thumbsup: happy to help with dashboards and alerting thresholds. Claire, do you prefer Grafana or a linked BigQuery view?
claire.wu: both. we’ll start with a shared BigQuery dataset + lightweight Grafana dashboards for ops teams.
hr-bot: Onboarding checklist for new hire Claire Wu: 1) Hardware access request submitted 2) KMS role pending approval 3) Welcome all-hands scheduled 4/10 10:30am PT — link: https://intranet/redwood/onboarding/claire-wu
maria.gonzalez: We'll post a calendar invite for intro coffee chats and add Claire to the Optimize and Runtime channels. Please join me in welcoming Claire! :tada:
